en: Rosa
I came to try the Battle Subway, and guess who turned up? The Subway Bosses themselves!
They'll battle out here, but only two on two. I need a partner!
Will you battle the Subway Bosses beside me?
Really? Thanks! I'm Rosa. Let's be the best partners ever!
Nate
I came to try the Battle Subway, and guess who turned up? The Subway Bosses themselves!
They'll battle out here, but only two on two. I need a partner!
Will you battle the Subway Bosses beside me?
Really? Thanks! I'm Nate. You and me together, we'll be better than perfect!
Ingo
A battle in the open air instead of aboard our trains? Most irregular! Still, new scenery may teach me something.
Emmet, have you anything to add?
Emmet
Two on two, rules are rules! Destination: victory. All aboard!
Ingo
Bravo! You and your Pokémon make a truly splendid team!
Emmet
I'm Emmet. We lost, but I had fun! Let's battle again sometime!
Ingo
Next time, ride the Battle Subway and challenge us aboard! Now we must be off. All aboard!
Rosa
Even holding back, they were so strong! That's the Subway Bosses for you. Thanks, {player}! This is for you!
Nate
Even holding back, they were so strong! That's the Subway Bosses for you. Thanks, {player}! This is for you!
With a Vs. Recorder you can keep your battles and watch them again. I had a great time battling beside you. See you!
Not ready yet? That's OK! I'll keep them talking. Come back when you are!
Ingo
I am Ingo, a Subway Boss. Usually you'll find me battling aboard the trains that leave from the Gear Station.
Emmet
I'm Emmet, a Subway Boss! I love Double Battles. Two Pokémon working as one, that's the best!
{rival}
{player}! Cover me!
{rival}
Hold it! What are you lot up to here?
Grunt
Up to? Nothing. We're just standing about. So why are you bothering us?
{rival}
Maybe you haven't done anything to me. But I'll never forgive Pokémon thieves like you. Never!
Grunt
Kids these days. You think your Pokémon's strength is your own? I don't like being pushed around!
{rival}
{player}! Cover me!
Grunt
Heh heh! I stole this Pokémon two years ago and I've trained it hard ever since. It's tough!
What?! I toughened it up for two whole years!
Grunt
My turn! And I show no mercy!
We give up! Beaten by two kids... Fine. Since you're so strong, I'll tell you this much.
Team Plasma is searching for something. Once we find it, our secret weapon will show its true power!
Farewell!
{rival}
Five years ago, Team Plasma stole my little sister's Purrloin. It was a present.
I was just a kid. I couldn't do a thing. That's why I have to get stronger!
Good work back there. I knew you had good instincts! Here, let me see to your team.
{rival} healed your Pokémon.
Listen. Fill up that Pokédex, keep getting stronger, and keep backing me up. I'm counting on you!
